verified_facts.text: The Standard Spa, Miami Beach is for adults and describes itself as less a hotel and more a spa with guest rooms.

verified_facts.text: Spa facilities include hydrotherapy, a Turkish-style hammam, an aroma steam room, a sauna, an ice room, a Roman waterfall hot tub, an arctic plunge, treatment baths and an infinity pool.

verified_facts.text: The hotel hosts retreats, lectures, classes, seminars and events led by local, national and international figures in health, fitness, spirituality, art and more.
